Deformed
Source Inner Sea Gods pg. 219, Faiths of Corruption pg. 7
Category Religion
Requirement(s) Lamashtu
Your monstrous deformities grant you a +1 trait bonus on Intimidate checks, and Intimidate is a class skill for you.
